Domestic investors direct capital to foreign countries through the purchase of securities issued by foreign entities. B. Domestic investors direct capital to foreign countries through loans and grants issued to promote development. C. Domestic investors direct capital to foreign countries through the purchase of land, labor, and physical capital. D. Domestic investors direct capital to foreign countries through the merging of domestic and foreign businesses.
questions_and_answers.answer: The foreign portfolio investment contributes to economic development is Domestic investors direct capital to foreign countries through the purchase of securities issued by foreign entities. The correct option is (A). What do you mean by the foreign portfolio investment? Holding financial assets from a nation other than the investor's own is referred to as a foreign portfolio investment (FPI). Stocks, ADRs, GDRs, bonds, mutual funds, and exchange-traded funds are all examples of possible FPI holdings. Investors have an easy option to diversify their portfolio abroad through foreign portfolio investments. In order to get a higher risk-adjusted return, an investor would diversify their investment portfolio, which is ultimately done to contribute to the creation of alpha. questions_and_answers.answer: Domestic investors direct capital to foreign countries through the purchase of securities issued by foreign entities.. A. Foreign portfolio investment can contribute to economic development by allowing domestic investors to direct capital to foreign countries through the purchase of securities issued by foreign entities. On the other hand, directing capital through loans and grants issued to promote development is more aligned with foreign direct investment rather than foreign portfolio investment. Similarly, the purchase of land, labor, and physical capital, as well as the merging of domestic and foreign businesses, are also more characteristic of foreign direct investment rather than foreign portfolio investment.
